sources: recreation.gov campsite catalog for 233741 (public search API, 10 sites), read 2026-10-22

values.note: 10 standard non-electric sites. Trailer/RV parking spurs average 14 x 60 ft and 28 x 35 ft; no maximum vehicle length is published.

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/custergallatin/recreation/chisholm-campground ('Camp sites: 10'; 'Trailer/RV Sites Average Parking spur: 14' x 60'; 28' x 35'') + recreation.gov catalog for 233741 (10 STANDARD NONELECTRIC, Max Vehicle Length blank on all), read 2026-10-22

hookups.source: recreation.gov campsite catalog for 233741 (all 10 sites STANDARD NONELECTRIC, Water Hookup 'No'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Accessible vault toilets, hand-pump drinking water, trash and recycling, food storage lockers, host on site; firewood sold.

facilities.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233741 (amenities 'Accessible Vault Toilets', 'Drinking Water (hand pump)', 'Food Storage Locker', 'Host', 'Recycling', 'Trash Collection'; notices 'No RV Dump Station is located in any of the USFS campgrounds managed by ExplorUS in the Custer-Gallatin National Forest.', 'There are NO Showers located in this campground.') + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/custergallatin/recreation/chisholm-campground (Restrooms 'Vault toilet(s)'; 'Potable water is available at this site.'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: $9 for each additional vehicle (interagency passes do not apply to it). recreation.gov says the fee covers 2 vehicles or an RV/trailer with tow vehicle; the Forest Service page says it includes 1 driving vehicle.

fees.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233741/rates (2026 Peak Season STANDARD NONELECTRIC $26) + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/custergallatin/recreation/chisholm-campground ('$26.00 site fee includes 1 driving vehicle', '$9 each additional vehicle. Interagency Passes not applicable toward additional vehicle fees') + recreation.gov notice ('Camping fee covers 2 vehicles or RV/Trailer with tow vehicle'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Concession-run: the Forest Service names Rocky Mountain Recreation Company, recreation.gov lists ExplorUS. All 10 sites reservable on recreation.gov until 4 days before arrival.

booking.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233741 (rules maxConsecutiveStay 16, reservationCutOff 4; facility email @goexplorus.com; catalog: all 10 sites reservable) + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/custergallatin/recreation/chisholm-campground ('View this site on Recreation.gov'; 'Information: Rocky Mountain Recreation Company (661) 702-1420'), read 2026-10-22

note: Custer Gallatin National Forest campground (Bozeman Ranger District) in pine and fir next to Hyalite Reservoir at 6,700 ft, ~18 mi south of Bozeman on Hyalite Canyon Rd #62 (paved but for the last mile; road open 5/16-3/31). Boating/fishing on Hyalite Reservoir; Hyalite Peak Trail nearby. --Claude
